exams.title: Princeton Review Practice Test
exams.sourceFile: Cracking the GRE Mathematics Subject Test (Stephen A. Leduc) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

scoring.notes: This publisher practice test has 65 questions and no published test-specific raw-to-scaled conversion table. Results report the number correct out of 65; no GRE scaled-score estimate is calculated. The book discusses the historical wrong-answer penalty in its general introduction, but does not provide a scoring curve for this test. Correct choices follow the numbered answer explanations on PDF pages 432–454.

exams.editionNotes: Cracking the GRE Mathematics Subject Test, fourth edition, Steven A. Leduc, copyright 2010. This is the book’s single full-length publisher practice test (printed pages 406–420; answers and explanations 422–444), not an ETS released exam. Original 65-question count and 170-minute time limit are preserved.
